goal_text: Fermi estimate: How many piano tunings occur per year in Chicago? State assumptions for population, pianos per household, tuning frequency, and tuners' throughput. Compute low and high bounds and give a point estimate.
ground_truth: Pop ~2.7M, ~1M households, 1 piano per 50 households → 20k pianos, tuned once/year → 20k tunings; tuners do ~1000/year → ~20 tuners — order 10^4 tunings/year acceptable range 5k-40k

check_params.criteria: Does the answer list at least three explicit assumptions (population, piano ownership, or tuning frequency) and combine them into a numeric estimate?
